title: Skali installer init configuration
description: Cluster initialization configuration consumed by skali cluster init --config.

email.description: Email of the first admin account.

passwordFile.description: Path to a file holding the admin password.

api.description: Public api/ui domain, for example skali.example.com.

registry.description: Public managed-registry domain, for example cr.skali.example.com.

s3.description: Optional public S3 endpoint domain, for example s3.skali.example.com; empty keeps bucket access in-cluster.

preference.description: Ordered build platform preference for mixed-architecture clusters: the first entry an application supports wins its single-arch build. Entries are linux/amd64 or linux/arm64. Empty keeps the recorded choice, multi-arch builds on a fresh installation.

imageId.description: Optional image content identity behind a mutable tag.

driver.description: Application storage driver: local (default, k3s local-path, no replication or size enforcement) or longhorn (replicated block storage with enforced volume sizes). Empty keeps the recorded choice.

acmeServer.description: Optional ACME directory URL override; empty selects the Let's Encrypt production endpoint. Point test installations at the staging endpoint.

issuerEmail.description: ACME account email for certificate issuance.

image.description: skali-web console image reference to install.

imageId.description: Optional image content identity behind a mutable tag.
